name: OmaGAWD
author: David
description: Winamp soul. Omarchy fit. Badass llama dance moves. Jellyfin, local music and worldwide radio in a compact themed player. Real frequency spectrum, keyboard control, named playlists and recently played albums/stations. Gapless music, optional ReplayGain normalization, native file/folder drops and clear live-radio status. Discover stations by name, genre, country or language and save favourites. Settings includes playback options, sources, updates and shortcuts.

barWidget.description: Llama button for Jellyfin, local music and live radio
